svg.aria-label: Unit D wiring: 12V supply through F1 to red blocks, two LM2596 converters making the 9V valve rail on grey blocks and 5V on black for the ESP32, four DRV8871 boards driving the zone valves, four SEN0308 moisture sensors and the ultrasonic pond sensor through blue and grey signal blocks, sensor power on yellow 3.3V blocks and all grounds on green.
svg.text: DIN rail · 5 blocks of each colour
